meaning:
ὠτάριον, -ου, τό
= ὠτίον (which see),
the ear: Mrk.14:47, Jhn.18:10.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But a certain one of those who stood by drew his sword, and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
Simon Peter therefore, having a sword, drew it, struck the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.
